reuse.reason: No official Worker plugin renders localized public HTML metadata in this composition. The official locale package is a browser runtime and cannot serve crawlable HTML; this worker plugin owns the public HTML locale boundary. Default site artwork is generated at development time from the pinned ui-primitives stable FISH_LOGO_PATH/FISH_LOGO_VIEWBOX exports; no client code enters the Worker. Bundled transparent black/white favicons follow the pinned official web app SVG-only link-media pattern, without competing default ICO/PNG candidates and separately from installation tiles. Content-versioned asset references preserve administrator overrides. The development-only social-image renderer reads exported ui-theme Montserrat font assets because no stable font entry exists; the declared source entries are asset provenance, never Worker imports.
